derived_material_scales.interpretation: h50 is the absolute suction head at effective saturation Se=0.5 for the standard van Genuchten retention curve. It is used here only to characterize material transition scale, not as a qualified coordinate.

supported: The persistent two-geometry C7a tail failures are strongly associated with low NPAR and very broad retention-transition scales.
The O01/O05 20cm-only strong-gradient failures form a distinct geometry-sensitive family and are not explained by the low-NPAR pattern.
A single scalar material normalization should not be assumed to solve both families without independent evidence.
not_supported: deleting O12 because it is a counterexample
changing the already-running A0 nomination rule

fresh_holdout_rule: Any future candidate, classifier, regime split or coordinate motivated by this revealed characterization requires a separately precommitted fresh unseen holdout before qualification.
F_SI09_boundary: This artifact characterizes the frozen legacy C7a basis. Any later SWAP5-admitted-provider qualification must reconcile against the exact qualified F-SI09 corrected B1.10 constitutive provider and must not treat legacy near-saturation findings as unresolved owner defects by default.
